scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:fresh: npm run dev:stop && npm run dev
scripts.dev:local: npm run dev:stop && (docker start egas-postgres 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name egas-postgres -p 5432:5432 -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -v egas-postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:16) && DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/egas_clearance npm run dev
